about: Prism-DevRel content configuration for Verdant AQM: maps each of the five stakeholders declared in app/src/Architecture.lex.tex to the canonical five Prism guides (Kai, Iris, Vera, Wren, Otto), binds Diataxis quadrants and repository documentation paths to readers, and declares domain terms explained across docs/ and notebooks/.

personas.name: Kai
personas.need: Run standard Qiskit circuits, SamplerV2, and EstimatorV2 jobs on VerdantAqmBackend in minutes without cloud keys or dense qubit caps.

asks.discover: What is Verdant AQM, and how does it run my Qiskit circuits?
asks.evaluate: Does it pass Qiskit's own BackendV2 and Primitives V2 validation suites?
asks.learn: Walk me through building a Bell pair, sampling counts, and reading holo_kappa receipts.
asks.build: How do I execute parameterized PUBs in Python or Jupyter notebooks?
asks.scale: How do I share reproducible #uorc= snapshots and verified .ipynb notebooks?

personas.name: Iris
personas.need: Scale Clifford+T, MPS, and stabilizer workloads past classical 28-32 qubit dense statevector walls with exact algebraic norms.

asks.discover: Which algebraic substrates replace dense 2^n complex statevectors?
asks.evaluate: When does Verdant AQM route to StabilizerTableau, CyclotomicExact, or ExactMps?
asks.learn: Show me how Z_8 phase-monoid fusion and active-wire compression eliminate redundant work.
asks.build: How do I migrate Qiskit Aer workflows to unbounded VerdantAqmBackend options?
asks.scale: How fast do 100,000-qubit Clifford and 10,000,000-qubit sparse Clifford+T circuits run?

personas.name: Vera
personas.need: Cryptographic and constructive proof that every claimed theorem, oracle lock, UORC seal, and ratchet ceiling holds without hidden axioms.

asks.discover: Which claims are constructive theorems, empirical build checks, or open research?
asks.evaluate: Are all six ceilings of prism/parametric-ratchet/1 permanently zero on disk?
asks.learn: Where is each STRIDE threat, UORC wire boundary, and upstream SHA-256 lock defined?
asks.build: Can a planted cloning gate, tampered UORC frame, or magic literal slip past the gates?
asks.scale: How is VerdantAqm.holo attested and re-verified on every GitHub Pages deployment?

personas.name: Wren
personas.need: Explore rotated [[d^2, 1, d]] surface-code tropical decoding, UOR Atlas D_4 MTC braids, and complete AQ-01..AQ-23 documentation coverage.

asks.discover: Which capabilities (AQ-01..AQ-23) and topological substrates does Verdant AQM expose?
asks.evaluate: How are surface-code minimum-weight recovery paths and PU(22) braids verified?
asks.learn: Which guide and notebook teaches each capability without filler prose?
asks.build: How do I simulate odd-distance surface codes and OpenQASM 2.0 SkWeaver compilations?
asks.scale: How does evaluateDevRelPublishGate keep docs, notebooks, and upstream pins synchronized?

personas.name: Otto
personas.need: Exact API signatures, 28-instruction Target ISA tables, pure UORC wire layouts, and zero-import Wasm worker budgets.

asks.discover: What runs inside the Web Worker, Python SDK, and GitHub Pages bundle?
asks.evaluate: What are the wire-weight budgets, Wasm exports, and UORC transport exemptions?
asks.learn: Which CLI script builds, tests, ratchets, and verifies each artifact?
asks.build: What options do VerdantAqmBackend, SamplerV2, and EstimatorV2 accept?
asks.scale: How does input-addressed BLAKE3 kappa caching keep CI builds deterministic?

reading.tutorial: A tutorial: follow the steps in order. Each one works if the one before it did.
reading.howToGuide: A how-to guide: each section is one step toward one task. Skip what you already have.
reading.reference: Reference: look up what you need. Nothing here asks to be read in order.
reading.explanation: Explanation: read it end to end, away from the keyboard.
reading.home: Start at the entry card for your role. Each path leads to the guide and notebook for one stakeholder.

terms.plain: Exact integer polynomial ring Z[zeta_8] scaled by powers of sqrt(2), representing Clifford+T amplitudes with zero floating-point rounding.
Binary F_2 matrix of 2n Pauli generators tracking n-qubit Clifford states in polynomial memory (Gottesman-Knill).
Qiskit Primitive Unified Bloc: a tuple of (circuit, observables, parameter_values, precision_or_shots) passed to SamplerV2 or EstimatorV2.
Universal Object Reference Container: SHA-256-sealed binary wire envelope (magic bytes b"UORC") carrying all post-boot state, snapshots, and coded matrices.
Permanent governance gate (prism/parametric-ratchet/1, FI-08) holding ontology literals > 1, Classical.choice, and magic constants at zero.
